intent: A fen warden's courtly gown of pale willow-bark lamellar banded in fen green over bog iron: from the high camera the wide bust tapers to a dark belt and bone sash, then a bone-trimmed bell of a skirt opens wider band by band to its hem.
requests: A soft, semi-transparent cloth for the veil; armour parts carry only an opaque colour, so the veil had to be a solid green slab.
A pale reed-straw bright enough for a whole skirt under the night preset without passing the bible's value limit; willow plates at oatmeal's value still read grey-brown from the ARPG camera.
